attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 branch_stock on node1 with the supplied records intact. Configured distinct SCRAM credentials, TLS-only access from node2, least-privilege role grants, and persistent firewall/service settings. Both nodes retained RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 and passed sequential restart/recovery verification.
